list.title: AI Sales Assistant Agent
list.description:
Built a small AI assistant agent in VSCode using Python and LangChain to answer customer and pricing questions. It follows a ReAct-style architecture with tool use (CRM lookup, pricing retrieval, and a knowledge-base RAG tool), dynamically selects the right tool per query, and generates a final response.  
Chat demo: https://sales-assistant-agent.onrender.com/chat  
API docs: https://sales-assistant-agent.onrender.com/docs  
Try out the clickable prompt bubbles inside the chat.

list.title: Karate Portal (Final Bootcamp Project)
list.description: Built a full-stack karate portal where users can sign up, log in, manage their karateka profile, browse techniques, and explore martial-arts personalities with CRUD functionality.

list.title: P5 Browser Game
list.description: Developed an entertaining Chrome browser game using P5.js, focused on interactive gameplay and front-end logic.

list.title: React Dictionary App
list.description: Created a React-based dictionary application integrating live data sources and user-friendly UI components.

list.title: Weather Web Application
list.description: Built a weather web app with live API data integration and a responsive front-end experience.

list.title: COVID-19 Detection from Chest X-Ray Images
list.description: Data science project on COVID-19 detection from chest X-ray images, developed collaboratively in a group setting. Includes a Grad-CAM interpretability demonstration in a Streamlit app currently running on localhost (not hosted).
